documents.text: A durable monitor observes terminal, file, browser, note, API, connector or agent events. It delivers only matches into its originating conversation, never an unrelated chat.
Clearing or archiving a conversation deletes monitors and pending deliveries. The old transcript retains a stopped-monitor notice. Continuing it does not restore subscriptions.
Tool search loads callable tool schemas in the next model round and retains them only for this turn. Discovery is conversation local and conveys no approval.
Memory documents are authoritative Markdown files storing durable facts. The search index is derived and can be rebuilt without changing or deleting the originals.
Skills describe reusable procedures, with a SKILL.md file and optional supporting files. An explicitly named skill is read even when embeddings are offline.
Standing notes are read into every prompt. They hold the user’s preferences and ongoing instructions, not a diary of completed actions.
When vector inference is unavailable, knowledge search returns keyword results with explicit fallback status. Empty search results are never exhaustive proof.
Qwen3-Embedding-8B uses last-token pooling, normalized 4096-dimensional vectors and query instruction prefixes. Documents are embedded without query instructions.
Vectors from different models, revisions, quantizations, dimensions or encoding settings stay in separate profiles. Switching profiles cannot mix incompatible vectors.
The bundled llama.cpp embedding server runs locally on a desktop, using Metal on Apple Silicon and supported CPU or GPU backends on other platforms.
The OpenAI API embedding provider supports text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large using a sealed API key. Codex sign-in embeddings are unverified.
The OpenRouter embedding provider supports qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b and requires an explicitly selected provider with its own sealed API key.
Another paired desktop can share embedding inference over authenticated routing. Only bounded text inputs and vectors travel; the search database remains on its own runtime.
An unavailable selected inference device does not cause automatic provider switching. Offline monitor sources reconnect with a new silent baseline.
Terminal monitoring combines incremental output across chunk boundaries and observes process state and exit codes. A phrase split between chunks can still match.
File monitoring uses an approved project scope, filesystem notifications and reconciliation. It detects external edits, renamed files and atomic save replacements.
Browser monitors observe the current live session and debounced DOM text, optionally limited to a CSS selector. Page content remains untrusted data.
HTTP probes are read-only and default to a thirty-second interval. They inspect response status, selected headers, text and JSON fields under existing network guards.
Discord, Slack, Telegram, Matrix, Teams, Twilio and mail monitors reuse existing ingestion or polling. Initial quiet batches establish a baseline without historical notification floods.
Exact all, any and not filters support equality, substring containment, bounded wildcards, numeric comparison and changed fields. Exact rejection occurs before any semantic inference.
An optional semantic monitor gate compares an observation with a query using cosine similarity. Inference failure visibly blocks delivery and never bypasses the gate.
The Tasks interface displays monitors, filters, recent matches, errors, pause, resume and deletion. Watching monitors do not consume ordinary running task capacity.
Monitor creation authorizes observation only. It does not authorize replies, purchases, deletion or other external actions, and tool discovery never grants permission.
MCP definitions, credentials and trust are revalidated before execution. A changed tool schema must be rediscovered and proposed again before it can run.
Every model dialect repairs tool-call and tool-output pairs before replay. A stopped or rejected tool still receives an output so later rounds stay valid.
Notepad and notebook documents share an authoritative store. Trashed or deleted notes are excluded from ordinary retrieval, and shared references are deduplicated.
Extracted attachment text retains page references for retrieval. Images and handwriting without transcription are not treated as extracted text.
Project roots and workspaces.db remain local to their desktop. Native execution is not enabled on the ordinary server, and project files are excluded from this search index.
Local model setup downloads verified model files with progress and cancellation. The pinned file size and SHA-256 are checked before installation.
On macOS entirely unused pages do not describe all available headroom. The operating-system memory pressure estimate includes reclaimable capacity more appropriately.
Child agents have their own conversations and inherit their parent’s tool policy. Finished child conversations receive monitor cleanup, and stale notifications cannot wake new threads.
Matching-event receipts and deduplication keys persist in SQLite. Bursts are coalesced and deliveries revalidate ownership, monitor revision, cancellation and conversation lifecycle.
